Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.
Matter is taken up in the revised call.

By means of the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.
773 of 2022 at Police Station- Tazganj, District- Agra under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 304B I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
The applicant is in jail since 17.10.2022.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 28.09.2023.

The following arguments made by Shri Rahul Pandey, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant,
which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Brijesh Kumar Srivastava, learned counsel on behalf of the informant and Shri Shravan Kumar Dubey, learned AGA from the record, entitle the Mahesh Alias Deepak vs State Of U.P. on 16 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/9350913/
1 applicant for grant of bail:
1. The applicant is the husband of the deceased.
2. The applicant did not harass the deceased nor demanded dowry.
5. The deceased and applicant were estranged.
6. The deceased started staying with the applicant in compliance of court's order as a part of process of reconciliation.

sentences.text: However, their relations remained strained.
7. The deceased was a temperamental lady who was prone to extreme reactions over trivial issues.
8. On the fateful day after a minor argument with the members of household, she locked herself up in a room and took the extreme step of ending her life.
She committed suicide by hanging.
9. The door had to be broken open to retrieve the dead body.
10. The postmortem report opines the cause of death as asphyxia due to antemortem hanging.

11. Injuries depicted in the postmortem report consistent with hanging are:
(i) Nature of ligature mark.
(ii) The hyoid bone was intact.
12. The applicant did not aid or abet the suicide.
13. Prosecution evidence do not connect the applicant with the offence.
14.
The prerequisites for attracting the presumption and the reversing the burden of proof are not established in the facts and circumstances and evidence of the case.
15. The applicant has explained his criminal history.
It is also contended that the applicant has become a soft target and a convenient scapegoat for the police authorities who nominated him in a false case to burnish their professional credentials.
The said case does not have any bearing on the instant bail application.
16. The applicant is not flight risk.
The applicant being law abiding citizen have always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to join the trial proceedings.
There is no possibility of their influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.

sentences.text: In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant- Mahesh Alias Deepak be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
( ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

The learned trial court is directed to fix the sureties after due application of mind in light of the judgement rendered by this Court in Arvind Singh v. State of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Deptt.
(Application U/S 482 No.2613 of 2023).
